drop.why: moved to New Bahru in 2024 (Michelin); batch C has the right address

Burnt Ends.london: The Barbary's counter and fire, at four or five times the price: budget S$250+ a head

Fico (East Coast Park).london: Padella-ish pasta with a sea view

Fico at Tanjong Beach Club.d: Fico's second site, opened 28 Sep 2026 inside a Sentosa beach club. Untested: about three weeks old and no critic has been yet, so the parent's Bib Gourmand does not transfer. Beach-club setting, so style-over-substance risk.
Fico at Tanjong Beach Club.src: Opening report only (Little Big Red Dot, Sep 2026); no review yet

Belimbing.tip: Book dinner. Set menu was S$88++ for four courses in 2025 (now possibly five), so budget about S$110-130 a head with ++ and a drink. Order the red prawn kueh pie tee, wok-fried nasi ulam and the corn salat.

Samy's Curry.tip: About S$15 a head without fish head; a fish-head curry for the table pushes it to S$30-35.

Min Jiang at One-North.src: No independent rating for this branch found (its Dempsey sister is Michelin-listed); lower confidence

Singapore Zam Zam.src: No current critic rating found; listed for the institution (est. 1908), with Time Out and Travelfish mentions

Timbre+ One-North.src: My pick, for convenience: the campus local. The food is middling
Timbre+ One-North.london: Maltby Street Market energy, which you rated a 2

Fiz.src: Michelin Green Star 2026 (a sustainability award, not a cooking rating); Tatler Best 2026

Lei Garden.d: Hong Kong Cantonese institution, part of a multi-outlet group, starred and unflashy. Weekend dim sum is the move.

Swee Choon Tim Sum.d: The supper dim sum institution since 1962, now a multi-outlet brand; this is the original. Open daily 7am-2am, till 4am Fri-Sat (from Jan 2026). Queues after midnight are part of it.

Delhi Lahori.london: Tayyabs: the charcoal naan and seekh

Seroja.london: Acre's produce-first instinct, as a two-star tasting menu

Chatterbox.src: No current critic rating found; listed as the institution it is (2025-26 blog reviews mixed)

Imperial Treasure Fine Teochew Cuisine.d: Starred Teochew from the Imperial Treasure restaurant group, in ION Orchard: cold crab, braised goose, oyster omelette done properly. Reliable rather than a one-off room.
